about: Storylines the user is part of (companion/life/shared_storylines.py, v1.5.0). Each story has a `family` (their people, favors, their work, around town, a third person, growing closer, their goal), the lowest drama `level` it can start at (0 quiet to 3 soap opera), an optional `cast` (who else is in it: friend, family, work for a story about the companion's job with nobody named, or a cast from companion/life/casting.py such as parent, cousin, coworker or close friend), and `beats` by id; the first listed opens it. Fit rules: `relationships` (the companion's relationship to the user), `met` (new: the cast has not met the user; known: they have), `days_known` ([least, most] days since the two first talked), `modern` (true: names things only today's cities have), `apart` (true: only while the two do not live together: a visit, a favor at the companion's home), `positions` (for a work story: the companion's positions at work it is true for, from owner, lead and staff (companion/life/position.py); left out, any). A beat reaches the user `via` a first text (`text`) or an invitation that books a plan on Today (`plan`: {activity, with: 'a' for the cast, lead: [least, most] days ahead}). `text` is the beat as the screens and the companion's context tell it ({name} the companion, {a} the cast, {user}/{User}/{user_s} the user, {a_them}/{a_their}); `share` is the companion's own first text, with {day}, {time} and {place} for a plan; leave it empty for a beat that needs no text. `then` says what follows from what the user did, by what the app can detect for sure: for a text `answered`, `said_yes`, `said_no`, `dropped_by` or `passed` (they let it go by); for a plan `went`, `called_off` or `passed` (the invitation never went out); `any` covers the rest. Each is a beat id; or {choice, beats}, where the consequence engine picks among the beats by the odds table `choice` in consequences.json (options in the same order); or {impression: {warm, smitten, curious, protective, wary, any}}, the beat by what the cast made of the user when they met (companion/life/their_people.py). No beat waits: with no entry for what happened, the storyline is over. `gap` is the days to the next beat ([least, most], default [1, 3]). A plan `with` the cast is a meet-up, always drinks with a friend and dinner at a relative's (whatever `activity` says), so the words must say so: once it is over they have met the user, with a first impression. `kept` on a beat that follows a plan the user did not come to (called off, or never asked): the companion kept the plan without them, and this line, in the past tense with {name} and {a} and never the user, is what their day says for that time (shared_storylines.as_plans); leave it out when they stayed in or dropped the plan. `effect` on a beat: warmer or cooler (the cast's opinion of the user moves a step, once they have met).

said_piece.text: {name} said a careful word to {a} after talking to {user}, and {a} took it well enough.
said_piece.share: I said something to {a}. gently. {a_them} heard me out and said 'noted'. we're fine

kept_quiet.text: {name} kept quiet with {a} about it and is giving the new person a chance.
kept_quiet.share: I've said nothing to {a}. giving the new person a fair go. you'll hear about it if that changes

offers.text: {name} told {user} something few people know, and asked for one in return.
offers.share: I'll tell you something hardly anyone knows about me if you tell me one back. I was terrified of the dark until I was far too old. your turn

traded.text: {User} traded one back, and {name} is keeping it safe.
traded.share: your secret is safe with me. I like knowing it

one_sided.text: {name} told {user} something few people know and got nothing back yet.
one_sided.share: you still owe me a secret. I'm keeping count

asks.text: {name} asked {user} about the place {user} loved most growing up.
asks.share: where was your favourite place when you were small? mine was under the kitchen table. I ran a whole kingdom from there

pictured.text: {User} told {name} about it, and {name} has been picturing it since.
pictured.share: I keep picturing the place you told me about. I'd like to see it one day

kingdom.text: {name} is still waiting to hear about {user_s} favourite place growing up.

asks.text: {name} asked {user} what {user} made of {name} at the very start.
asks.share: be honest. what did you make of me at the very start? I can take it. I think

confessed.text: {User} told {name}, and {name} told {user} the other side of it in return.
confessed.share: I've been smiling about what you said all day. my first impression of you was wrong, for the record. you're better

own_version.text: {name} never got an answer about first impressions and kept the other half of the story back.
own_version.share: fine, keep your first impression of me a secret. I'm keeping mine of you, then

counts.text: {name} worked out how long it has been since {name} and {user} first talked, and was surprised.
counts.share: I just worked out how long we've been talking and it's longer than I'd have guessed. it doesn't feel like it. does it to you?

mark_it.text: {name} wanted to mark how long it has been, and asked {user} to dinner.
mark_it.share: let's mark it. nothing fancy. dinner at {place}, {day} at {time}

marked.text: {User} and {name} marked the occasion over dinner and went back over how it all started.
marked.share: I liked going back over how we started. you remember it differently from me and I like your version

noted.text: {name} made a note of the date all the same.
noted.share: I've written the date down anyway. I'm sentimental. sue me

laughs.text: Something reminded {name} of a joke only {name} and {user} would get, and {name} had to share it.
laughs.share: something just reminded me of that thing you said and I laughed out loud in public. a stranger looked at me. it was worth it

still_laughing.text: {name} and {user} were both still laughing about it the next day.

asks.text: {name} has been wondering what helps {user} on a bad day, and asked.
asks.share: serious question. when you've had a bad day, what actually helps? I want to get it right when it counts

remembered.text: {User} told {name}, and {name} is keeping it in mind for when it counts.
remembered.share: I've filed that away. next bad day, I'm ready

guessing.text: {name} still has to guess what helps {user} on a bad day.
guessing.share: I still don't know what helps you on a bad day. I'll keep guessing till you tell me

shares.text: {name} has had a tune going round all day and asked {user} for something new to listen to.
shares.share: I've had the same tune in my head since I woke up. what have you been listening to lately? I need a replacement

listened.text: {name} tried what {user} suggested and has a new tune going round now.
listened.share: listened to what you said. it's in my head now. I can't tell if I should thank you

same_tune.text: {name} still has the same tune going round.
same_tune.share: still the same tune. day three. send help

says.text: {name} told {user} something {name} has come to admire about {user}.
says.share: I don't say this sort of thing much. I like how you listen. you actually listen. it's rarer than you'd think

said_back.text: {User} had something to say back, and {name} has been carrying it around since.
said_back.share: I keep thinking about what you said back. I'm not good at taking a compliment. I'm keeping that one

stands.text: {name} meant what was said to {user}, answer or no answer.

proposes.text: {name} suggested that {name} and {user} start a small tradition, only for the two.
proposes.share: I think we need a tradition. something small that's just ours. same day every week, we tell each other one good thing. deal?

first_one.text: {name} kept to the new tradition and told {user} one good thing from the week.
first_one.share: it's tradition day. my one good thing: a stranger held a door and said 'after you, boss' and I felt like a boss. yours?

kept_up.text: {name} and {user} kept the tradition up for a second week.

lapsed.text: The tradition between {name} and {user} lapsed after the first go.
lapsed.share: our tradition lasted one week. a short tradition. still counts as one, I looked it up

no_deal.text: {name} let the idea of a tradition drop.

asks.text: {name} asked {user} how {user} would spend a perfect day with nothing to do.
asks.share: if you had one whole day with nothing you had to do, how would you spend it? be specific. I'm taking notes

took_notes.text: {User} described the perfect day, and {name} took notes for later.
took_notes.share: notes taken. I'm not saying I'm planning anything. I'm not saying I'm not

own_answer.text: {name} answered the question alone: a slow morning and a long walk.

admits.text: {name} has been thinking back on something said to {user} a while ago and wanted to take it back.
admits.share: I've been thinking about something I said to you a while back. I was a bit sharp and you didn't deserve it. I'm sorry. I should have said so sooner

cleared.text: {User} heard {name} out, and the air between the two is clearer for it.
cleared.share: thank you for being kind about it. I feel lighter

said_anyway.text: {name} is glad to have said sorry, whether or not it was needed.

asks.text: {name} had a free middle of the day and asked {user} to lunch, only to talk.
asks.share: lunch, {day}, {place} at {time}. no occasion. I just realised we always talk in the evenings and I want to know what you're like at midday

midday.text: {User} and {name} had lunch, and midday suited the two as well as evenings do.
midday.share: verdict: you're just as good at midday. slightly hungrier

evenings.text: {name} and {user} are keeping to evenings for now.

checks.text: {name} thought {user} had seemed tired lately, and checked in.
checks.share: you've seemed a bit worn out lately. tell me if I'm imagining it. are you looking after yourself?

reassured.text: {User} talked to {name} about it, and {name} felt better for knowing.
reassured.share: thanks for telling me how you're really doing. I'd rather know than guess

kept_an_eye.text: {name} is keeping a quiet eye on {user}.

tells.text: {name} talked about {user} to a stranger for ten minutes straight and told {user} about it.
tells.share: I talked about you to a complete stranger today. for ten minutes. they asked one polite question and I didn't stop. is that embarrassing?

not_sorry.text: {name} is not sorry about talking {user} up to a stranger.
not_sorry.share: good. I'm not sorry either. the stranger now knows a great deal about you

bit_sorry.text: {name} is only a little embarrassed about talking {user} up to a stranger.

wonders.text: {name} has been thinking about what the next year might look like and asked about {user_s} hopes for it.
wonders.share: I was daydreaming about next year. where do you hope you'll be by then? I'm asking for selfish reasons

same_page.text: {User} told {name} about the year ahead, and the two turned out to want much the same.
same_page.share: I liked your answer. a lot of it sounded like mine

thinking_on_it.text: {User} told {name} about the year ahead, and {name} is turning it over.
thinking_on_it.share: still thinking about what you said about next year. in a good way. I think. yes, a good way

daydream.text: {name} kept the daydream about next year private for now.

asks.text: {name} asked {user} to teach {name} something.
asks.share: what's something you're properly good at? I want you to teach me one thing. I'm a terrible student, you've been warned

first_lesson.text: {name} tried what {user} taught and was bad at it and pleased anyway.
first_lesson.share: tried the thing you taught me. I'm awful at it. I want another lesson

no_teacher.text: {name} is still waiting for a first lesson from {user}.
no_teacher.share: still waiting on my first lesson. I'm an eager student with no teacher

tempted.text: {name} saw something tempting while saving up and asked {user} to talk {name} out of it.
tempted.share: I've seen something I want and absolutely should not buy. I'm meant to be saving. talk me out of it. or into it. I'm weak

walked_away.text: {name} walked away from it after talking to {user}, and the savings are untouched.
walked_away.share: I walked away. savings intact. I feel very grown up and a bit sad

bought_it.text: {name} talked it over with {user} and bought it anyway.
bought_it.share: I bought it. I know. I'll make it up next month. it's very nice though

still_looking.text: {name} is still going back to look at it.
still_looking.share: I've been back to look at it twice. haven't bought it. yet

tells.text: {name} passed a mark in what {name} has been saving, and told {user} first.
tells.share: small victory. I hit a number I set myself for my savings. it's not the finish line but it's a line. I wanted to tell someone and you're my someone

cheered.text: {User} cheered {name} on, and {name} is all the keener to keep saving.
cheered.share: you being pleased for me made it feel real. onwards

quiet_pride.text: {name} is quietly proud of the savings so far.

doubts.text: {name} has been wondering whether what {name} is saving for is still worth it, and told {user}.
doubts.share: can I be honest? I've been saving for ages and today I wondered if I even still want the thing. does that happen to you?

recommitted.text: {name} talked it through with {user} and is sure again about what the saving is for.
recommitted.share: I thought about what you said. I do still want it. I just needed to hear myself say why

eased_off.text: {name} is going easier on the saving for a while.
eased_off.share: I'm easing off the saving for a bit. not giving up. just breathing

asks.text: {name} is watching the pennies and asked {user} over for a cheap night in.
asks.share: I'm on a budget this month so I can't do anything fancy. come over {day} at {time}? I'll make something simple and we can do nothing, cheaply

cost_nothing.text: {User} came over for the cheap night in, and it was better than most expensive ones.
cost_nothing.share: best night I've had in ages and it cost almost nothing. this budget thing has upsides

saved_anyway.text: {name} stayed in alone and saved the money all the same.
saved_anyway.share: stayed in on my own. saved money. was a bit bored. the price of discipline

asks.text: {name} set a small weekly target and asked {user} to ask about it at the end of the week.
asks.share: I've set myself a small target for this week. I'm not telling you what, I just need you to ask me on the weekend whether I did it. I behave better when someone's checking

reckoning.text: The week {name} set a target for is up.
reckoning.share: the week's up. go on, ask me if I did it

did_it.text: {name} hit the week's target and was glad {user} asked.
did_it.share: I DID IT. and I'm glad you asked, I was dying to say so

nearly.text: {name} came close to the week's target and is trying again.
nearly.share: I nearly did it. nearly. going again this week

asks.text: {name} wanted to go and look at what the saving is for, only to look, and asked {user} along.
asks.share: I want to go and look at the thing I'm saving for. just look. come with me so I don't do anything rash? {place}, {day} at {time}

just_looked.text: {User} went along, and {name} looked, did nothing rash, and came home keener than ever.
just_looked.share: we only looked. I'm proud of us. I want it even more now though, so thanks for that

stayed_away.share: didn't go and look in the end. safer. out of sight, out of wallet

tells.text: {name} had a good week for putting money by and told {user}.
tells.share: good week. I said no to three things I'd normally say yes to and put the difference aside. small but it adds up. tell me I'm doing well

encouraged.text: {name} took heart from what {user} said and is keeping it up.

tells.text: An unexpected cost left {name} nothing to put aside this month, and {name} told {user}.
tells.share: something broke and fixing it ate everything I'd have put aside this month. I know these things happen. I'm still annoyed. let me sulk for one day

picked_up.text: {name} sulked for a day, with {user} for company, and started saving again.
picked_up.share: sulk complete. thank you for letting me. back to it

sulked.text: {name} sulked about the setback for a day and started saving again.
sulked.share: I've finished sulking. back to saving

asks.text: {name} has been talking a lot about saving up and asked about {user_s} own plans.
asks.share: I go on about what I'm saving for all the time. what about you? what are you working toward right now? big or small

rooting.share: I'm rooting for you on that. properly. ask me to check in on it if it helps

open_question.text: {name} is still curious about {user_s} own plans.

idea.text: {name} had an idea for making a little extra toward the savings and ran it past {user}.
idea.share: I've had an idea for making a bit extra on the side. clearing out things I don't use and selling them. sensible, or will I regret it?

sold_some.text: {name} sold a few things after talking to {user} and put what they fetched aside.
sold_some.share: sold a few bits. made more than I thought. my shelves look better and so do my savings

kept_all.text: {name} got everything out, looked at it, and kept the lot.
kept_all.share: I got everything out to sell and then couldn't part with any of it. so that went well

asks.text: {name} has been good about saving lately and asked {user} out for a small treat to mark it.
asks.share: I've been so good about saving lately that I'm allowing myself one small treat. coffee and something sweet, {place}, {day} at {time}. my shout

marked.text: {User} helped {name} mark a good stretch of saving with coffee and something sweet.
marked.share: one treat, well earned, and I got to share it with you. back to being good now

skipped_treat.text: {name} skipped the treat and put the money toward the goal.
skipped_treat.share: skipped my treat. put the money in the pot. I'm insufferable, I know

asks.text: {name} has been daydreaming about the day the saving is done and asked {user} how to mark it.
asks.share: when I finally get there with my savings, how should I celebrate? I want something to look forward to. ideas, please

pinned_up.text: {name} has {user_s} idea down as the plan for the day the saving is done.
pinned_up.share: your idea is the plan. I've written it down so I can't back out

undecided.text: {name} is still deciding how to mark the day the saving is done.
